news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to $1.9 million on accelerating PENFS/IB-Stim device unit growth (+60% YoY) and gross margin expansion, driven by the Category I CPT code for PENFS that took effect January 1, 2026. Cash stood at $8.3 million as of June 30, 2026, after the company raised $2.5 million via its ATM facility and warrant redemptions during the quarter.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS in the Mid-Atlantic region, extending IB-Stim access to more than 500,000 additional covered lives. The expansion builds on the permanent reimbursement pathway established by the new Category I CPT code.

news.headline: NeurAxis, Inc. Files Amended Shelf Registration Statement (Form S-3/A)
news.summary: NeurAxis filed an amended S-3 registration covering resale of shares by a selling stockholder, including shares underlying restricted stock units, following its July 23 initial shelf filing. The filing does not raise new capital for the company but keeps existing shares eligible for public resale.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it would report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call and webcast at 9:00 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: NeurAxis, Inc. Files Form S-3 Shelf Registration for Selling Stockholder Resale of Common Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis registered up to roughly 1.9 million shares of common stock, including RSU-underlying shares, for resale by a selling stockholder, a routine filing relevant to potential share supply and dilution monitoring.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: The board declared the quarterly 8.5% cumulative stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, paid in about 80,456 common shares on July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results expected in November 2026; watched for continued PENFS/IB-Stim unit growth, VA channel contribution, gross margin trajectory, and cash burn trends following management's guidance for higher H2 spend.

catalysts.label: Accelerated commercial investment phase
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the August 11 Q2 call that cash burn will increase in the second half of 2026 as the company ramps sales, marketing, and clinical research spend to accelerate PENFS/IB-Stim adoption.

catalysts.label: Further payer medical-policy coverage wins
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis continues to pursue additional health-plan medical policy coverage decisions beyond the 500,000+ lives added in the Mid-Atlantic in August 2026, building on the Category I CPT code (64567) effective January 1, 2026.

catalysts.label: Veterans Affairs Federal Supply Schedule rollout
catalysts.detail: Continued scale-up of IB-Stim adoption within the VA health system following the December 2025 FSS contract award, with territory rep hiring in mid-2026 aimed at driving VA revenue contribution.

catalysts.label: Adult functional dyspepsia indication commercial ramp
catalysts.detail: Commercial expansion of IB-Stim into the adult functional dyspepsia/associated nausea population following the October 2025 FDA clearance, broadening the addressable market beyond pediatric FAP/IBS.

pulse: NeurAxis is in a commercial inflection phase: Q2 2026 revenue grew 116% year-over-year to $1.9 million as PENFS/IB-Stim unit growth accelerated to +60% YoY, propelled by the new Category I CPT code (64567, effective January 2026) and expanding payer coverage, including a fresh 500,000+-life Mid-Atlantic policy win in August. The company held $8.3 million cash at quarter-end after improving operating cash burn, but management has guided to higher H2 2026 spend on sales, marketing and clinical research, keeping ongoing share-registration activity (S-3/ATM capacity up to $11.5 million) a live dilution consideration. With reimbursement largely secured, the next several quarters are a test of commercial execution across payer coverage breadth, the VA channel, and the adult functional dyspepsia ramp, with Q3 2026 results due around November.
